meta.title: AI automations for small businesses
meta.description: Veeboo AI builds and runs AI automations and agents for small teams: lead response, AI receptionists, meeting notes to CRM, invoice reconciliation. Book a free AI audit.

hero.title: AI automations that pay for themselves
hero.lede: We build and run the automations that answer your leads, book appointments, write up meetings and match invoices. Every account stays in your name.
hero.demoNote: Example runs. Times and names are illustrative.

runs.title: A portal enquiry at 11:42 at night

events.text: Priya asks about the 3-bed on Maple Street through a listing portal.
Reply sent on WhatsApp with the price, floor plan and two questions: budget and move date.
She answers. Pre-approved, moving in March.
Marked as a hot lead in the CRM and offered three viewing slots.
Viewing booked for Saturday 10:30. Agent Sam gets the summary on his phone.

runs.footer: First reply in under a minute. Nobody was awake.

bubble.text: Hi Priya, the 3-bed on Maple Street has a garden and a garage. Floor plan attached. What budget and move date do you have in mind?

runs.title: A missed call during the lunch rush

events.text: Daniel calls about a chipped tooth. Both front-desk lines are busy.
The AI receptionist picks up, checks it is not an emergency, and looks at the diary.
Books him in for Thursday 9:15 and sends the confirmation on WhatsApp.
Reminder sent. Daniel confirms with one tap.
He arrives. The front desk never had to call him back.

runs.footer: A call that used to go to voicemail became a booked chair.

bubble.text: You are booked for Thursday at 9:15. We will remind you the day before. Reply CHANGE to move it.

runs.title: A discovery call ends at 3:30

events.text: Maya finishes a 40-minute call with a new prospect.
Notes written: goals, budget, objections, and who signs off.
CRM deal updated: stage, value, next step and close date.
Follow-up email drafted in Maya's own style, with the proposal attached.
Maya reads it, changes one line and sends.

runs.footer: Six minutes after the call, the admin is finished.

bubble.text: Thanks for the time today. As promised, the proposal is attached, with the two options we talked through.

runs.title: Monday's bank feed for one client

events.text: 212 new bank lines and 187 supplier invoices arrive overnight.
Invoices read and matched to bank lines by amount, date and supplier.
196 lines matched and coded. 16 flagged with the reason for each.
Leah reviews the 16 exceptions and approves the batch.
Reconciliation done. Leah moves on to the next client.

runs.footer: A person checked 16 lines instead of 212.

bubble.text: Monday batch ready. 16 lines need a look, each with the reason it was flagged.

problem.lede: Small teams lose money in the gaps: the enquiry answered tomorrow, the call that rang out, the follow-up nobody wrote. These are the gaps we close.

faq.title: Questions owners ask first
faq.asideText: Something else on your mind? Bring it to the audit call. It is free and there is no pitch at the end.

items.q: What happens in the free AI audit?
items.a: You walk us through one slow, repetitive process on a 30-minute video call. Within two working days you get a short written plan: what to automate first, what it will cost to build and run, and what it should save. It is yours to keep, and you can take it to anyone.

items.q: Who owns the automations and the accounts?
items.a: You do. Everything is built inside accounts in your name: your n8n, Make or Zapier workspace, your CRM, your API keys. If we stop working together you keep all of it, along with a handover document.
No. The setup fee covers the build. The retainer runs month to month and you can cancel it with 30 days' notice.

items.q: What if the AI gets something wrong?
items.a: Each automation has rules for when to hand over to a person: an unusual request, a low-confidence answer, anything about money or health. During the pilot we review real conversations with you and tighten those rules before it runs on its own.
No. We build it, document it and run it. Your team needs one person who knows the current process well enough to tell us when the automation gets it wrong.

items.q: You are based in India. How does working together go?
items.a: By video call and a shared channel, with working hours that overlap the US, UK, UAE and Australia. You talk to the person who builds your automation, not an account manager.

items.q: What does it cost to run besides your fees?
items.a: The tools themselves: an automation platform, AI model usage, and phone or WhatsApp messaging if you use them. These are billed to your own accounts at cost, and the audit plan includes an estimate.
